text:
Football Italia Live Blog
Join us for all the build-up and action as it happens from today’s Serie A games, Bologna-Monza, Roma visiting Udinese, and the massive Derby della Madonnina Milan vs. Inter.
We begin this Halloween schedule at 14.00 GMT (15.00 CET) with Bologna coming off two straight wins to host stuttering Monza.
At 17.00 GMT (18.00 CET), Roma try to keep up with the joint leaders as they visit Udinese in crisis.
All eyes on San Siro at 19.45 GMT (20.45 CET) as Milan and Inter go head-to-head in the Derby della Madonnina.
- All
- Favourites 0
Roma bring Rodrigo Mora and Matias Soulé into the starting XI behind Donyell Malen, as Udinese hope Nicolò Zaniolo and Keinan Davis can dig them out of a crisis.
Click here for the full details.
Udinese: Okoye; Abankwah, Kabasele, Palma; Vojvoda, Karlstrom, Miller, Kamara; Zaniolo, Ekkelenkamp, Davis
Roma: Gollini; Ghilardi, Ndicka, Hermoso; Molina, Cristante, De Roon, Wesley: Soulè, Mora; Malen
Bologna came back from an early Monza goal to secure a third straight win thanks to Tommaso Pobega, Federico Bernardeschi, and the Lukasz Skorupski penalty save, their first home victory since April.
Monza threaten a late equaliser with Cutrone, but Skorupski is behind the angled drive!
El Azzouzi roll across first time, lays it on a silver platter for Mbangula, who balloons over!
Miranda free kick on target, but Tornqvist right behind it to smother.
Roma: Gollini; Ghilardi, Ndicka, Hermoso; Molina, Cristante, De Roon, Wesley: Soulè, Mora; Malen
Amondarain into the book for Bologna.
We head into 6 minutes of added time.
Amondarain and Dovbyk on, Bernardeschi and Zortea off for Bologna.
Patrick Cutrone steps up, but Lukasz Skorupski goes the right way and saves the Monza penalty!
Third penalty of the game, second for Monza.
What are defenders even meant to do now? Harsh.
Ah it’s for potential Zortea handball on a cross. That looks harsh, but VAR review anyway!
Zortea arm wasn’t that far out, not that far from the body, and quite close to the Robinson cross.
VAR is checking something…
Not 100 per cent sure what. Robinson having words with Darmian.
Toure’ in the book for Monza
Poebga and Vitik off for Bologna, El Azzouzi and Darmian on
Robinson runs at Zortea and is getting away, brought down for the yellow card.
Cutrone and Ngonge on for Monza, Dany Mota and Varela off.
Colombo and Kouadio off, Toure’ and Mout on for Monza.
Mbangula on, Odgaard off for Bologna.
Witnessing the San Siro in person is breathtaking 😍
@IFTVMarco shows @T_Deeney around this colosseum of calcio for the first time ❤️
Stream the Derby della Madonnina on @paramountplus 📺 https://t.co/OBCQ1JjBPh
— CBS Sports Golazo ⚽️ (@CBSSportsGolazo) October 31, 2026
Tornqvist gets the right side, but cannot get to the finish, which is lifted just over the goalkeeper!
Yellow card for Lucchesi too. Bernardeschi steps up.
Inevitable decision.
Lucchesi had a big old handful of jersey… Not even trying to get the ball.
More Bologna penalty appeals, this time from Theate pulled back by Lucchesi as he goes for the header, he’s got a good old handful of jersey there…

המחזור בסריה א מתחיל עם שורת משחקים מרתקים, בראשם הדרבי דלה מדอนינה המסקרן בין מילאן לאינטר בסן סירו. קודם לכן, בולוניה מארחת את מונצה לאחר רצף תוצאות חיוביות, ורומא יוצאת למשחק חוץ מאתגר מול אודינזה במטרה להישאר קרובה לצמרת הגבוהה.

במשחקים עצמם נרשמת דרמה רבה, כולל בעיטות עונשין, התערבויות של מערכת ה-VAR ושערים מכריעים. בולוניה מצליחה לחזור לפיגור מוקדם כדי להבטיח ניצחון שלישי ברציפות, בזמן שרומא עולה בהרכב מתחדש הכולל את רודריגו מורה ומתיאס סולה, ומילאן ואינטר מתכוננות למפגש הענק שלהן לעיני הקהל באצטדיון.
